name: Vibrant flat sticker
summary: Jednoliate sýte pozadie v brand akcente, vyrezaný packshot, extra tučná verzálková typografia a vrstva bielych pill kariet a 3D emoji nálepiek. Brand-agnostický — farba sa berie z brand kariet.
when_to_use: Offer, zľava, doprava zadarmo, výpredaj, katalógový leták s mriežkou produktov, porovnanie s bežným produktom, social proof. Použiteľný pre každého klienta — mení sa len akcentová farba z brand kariet. Nepoužívať tam, kde má vyznieť prémiovosť alebo pokoj.
prompt_block: Render the image as a flat graphic-design composition, not a photographed or rendered 3D scene. Background is ONE completely flat, fully saturated brand accent colour filling the frame edge to edge, with no gradient, no vignette and no photographic texture; take that colour from the brand reference card and use it at full saturation, never a tint or a pastel. An optional very fine sparkle or glitter grain over the flat colour is allowed, nothing stronger. The product is a cut-out packshot with a clean isolated edge, placed large over the flat colour with a soft contact shadow beneath it, standing upright or tilted a few degrees, never in a photographic environment. Typography is one heavy geometric sans-serif family, ALL CAPS, pure white, tight letter spacing and tight leading, stacked over several lines; the key word or number is rendered two to three times larger than the qualifying line above it, creating a hard size contrast. Text sits flat on the colour with no outline, no drop shadow and no bevel. A layer of pure white containers carries the secondary information: fully rounded pills and rounded cards with generous padding, holding text in the brand accent colour or near-black, sometimes a white pill inside a slightly larger pale tint ring of the same accent. Prices appear inside a white pill: the old price struck through with a single line, the new price immediately beside it noticeably larger and bolder. Glossy three-dimensional emoji stickers (check mark, cross, stars, alarm clock, sparkles, flower, thumbs up) are scattered as a top layer with soft drop shadows, each one small and clearly separated. A friendly stylized 3D avatar head with an exaggerated expression may peek in from a corner or over the edge of a white card, cropped by the frame edge, treated as a sticker on top of the flat colour rather than part of a scene. Layout is a strict grid with generous empty colour between blocks: product on one side and the text stack on the other, or an even grid of product cells each with its own price pill and caption. Where a photograph is used at all, it is a bright soft-focus interior or textile scene placed inside a white rounded card, framed by the flat colour. Overall feel: loud, high-contrast, cheerful, unmistakably a promotion, readable at thumbnail size.
never: gradients, vignettes, glows or photographic texture on the background colour
the product photographed inside a real environment instead of cut out over the flat colour
script, cursive, handwritten or serif typography anywhere (the brand logo is added afterwards as a PNG overlay and is never drawn by the model)
outlines, drop shadows, bevels or 3D extrusion on any text
thin or light weight typography in the headline
muted, pastel or desaturated palettes, dark moody lighting or cinematic grading
flat vector clip-art emoji, drawn emoji or hand-drawn icons instead of glossy 3D emoji stickers
rendering any hex code, font name, percentage of a safe zone or measurement as visible text

variants.typo-hero: Packshot vľavo, obrovská verzálková typografia vpravo, kľúčové slovo cez celú šírku.
variants.offer-grid: Mriežka produktových buniek (3×2 aj viac), každá s cenovou pill a popiskom pod ňou. Katalógový leták.
variants.comparison: Vertikálny split — brand strana v sýtom akcente, strana bežného produktu v tlmenej šedo-fialovej #7A7F8C, obe s odrážkami ✅ a ❌.
variants.white-card: Veľká biela zaoblená karta na akcentovej ploche, vnútri fotka produktu, cenová pill a popis; roztrhnutý rožný štítok s urgenciou.
variants.social-proof: Fotka v pozadí, headline v akcentovej pill, okolo produktu rozhádzané biele recenzné kartičky natočené o pár stupňov s radom hviezd.
